title: Recorded conversation between Asst. Sec. of State Victoria Nuland and Amb. Jeffery Pyatt
summary: A leaked 2014 phone call between US Assistant Secretary of State Victoria Nuland and Ambassador Geoffrey Pyatt discussing a political transition in Ukraine. It includes a crude remark about the European Union.
why: Cited in Ukraine threads as primary-source evidence of US involvement in Ukrainian politics.

quote.text: Recorded call from 2014 between high-level US State Department officials, in which they work out who should go in what position in the Ukrainian government
